Design spec

Password reset screens

Three screens: enter the email, learn that it was sent, choose a new password. Never in doubt, and never telling whether an email is registered.

Status
In review
Owner
Design team
Date
2030-05-22
Screens
4

Goal

A member who forgot their password signs back in within a minute, on a phone too. Every screen shows one thing to do next.

Users

  • MemberCannot sign in and is in a hurry: short words and a large button, straight to the next step
  • Support agentPoints a member to "this button on this screen", and checks how a reset went

Screen flow

  1. Enter the emailPress Send the linkLearn it was sent
  2. Learn it was sentOpen the link in the emailChoose a new password

1 / 4

Enter the email

Reached by Forgot your password? on the sign-in screen

Notes

  1. One field only. The button works before anything is entered (empty, it shows a mistake under the field)

  2. Back to sign in is a text link, never beside the button

2 / 4

Learn it was sent

Shown every time, whether the email is registered or not

Notes

  1. The email address is not shown, so that no one learns whether it is registered

  2. No email? points to the spam folder and to sending again

3 / 4

Choose a new password

Opened by the link in the email

Notes

  1. The strength bar grows with each letter. The button works before it reads good, and shows a mistake if pressed

4 / 4

Password resets (support)

Support's console on a computer: find a member by email and see how each reset went

Notes

  1. Each result is a coloured tag, written in words as well as colour

  2. Device and place are shown only when the link was used

Design rules

Colors

  • Accent#1d6670Buttons and links
  • Good#1d7542The strength bar at good
  • Warning#8a5a10The mark of an ended link
  • Mistake#b3261eA field in a mistake
  • Ground#f4f3f0The screens' ground

Typography

  • Aa SampleScreen title24px / 700One on each screen
  • Aa SampleBody16px / 400
  • Aa SampleField label and mistake13px / 400

Components

Field
Its label over it, a mistake under it; red frame in a mistake
Main button
One on a screen, 52px tall
Strength bar
Three steps: weak, fair, good

UI text

Enter the email: title
Forgot your password?
Enter the email: button
Send the link
Learn it was sent: title
Check your email
Learn it was sent: body
We sent a link to choose a new password to your registered email. Open it within 30 minutes.
The link has ended: title
This link has ended

Accessibility

  • Text on buttons and fields is 4.5:1 or more against its ground
  • A mistake is told in words as well as colour, tied to its field by aria-describedby
  • Password fields can be filled by a password manager (autocomplete="new-password")

Open questions

  1. What sets the steps of the strength bar: the length or how hard it is to guess?Answers: Tech spec team
